engine.name: Browser data engine
engine.description: Parses structured and tabular data into a neutral value model and serializes it to the target format. Uses yaml, smol-toml and fast-xml-parser; CSV, TSV, INI, NDJSON, SQL, XLSX, HTML and Markdown writers are project code.
engine.license: Project code; yaml (ISC), smol-toml (BSD-3-Clause), fast-xml-parser (MIT), fflate (MIT)
